title: LabourFlow
desc: A digital platform for labour consultants designed to simplify client onboarding, organize compliance workflows, manage documents, and keep important tasks and deadlines in one place.
overview: A business-focused platform created for labour consultants to manage client-related compliance activities through a more organized digital workflow. The platform brings client information, documents, tasks, deadlines, and reporting into a connected workspace with role-based access.

title: KDM Associates
desc: A professional business website designed to present services clearly, strengthen the company's digital presence, and make it easier for potential customers to get in touch.
overview: A brand-focused website developed for a professional services business. The project focused on presenting the company and its services clearly, creating a trustworthy online presence, and providing straightforward ways for visitors to make contact.

title: Deep Blogs
desc: A modern content platform created for publishing and organizing articles with a structured content experience and responsive interface for readers.
overview: A self-initiated content platform focused on publishing, organizing, and presenting articles through a clean reading experience. The project includes content management functionality, categorization, search, and responsive layouts.

title: Quick Cart
desc: A full-stack e-commerce platform featuring product browsing, authentication, shopping cart management, and a structured online ordering experience.
overview: A demonstration e-commerce application created to explore common online-store workflows, including product discovery, customer accounts, cart management, checkout, order history, and administrative product and order management.
features: Product catalogue with search and filters

title: iDiscuss
desc: A real-time coding discussion platform designed for developers to share questions, exchange ideas, and participate in live conversations.
overview: A self-initiated community platform exploring real-time communication and developer discussions. The application combines discussion threads with real-time updates to create a more interactive experience for participants.

title: Wanderlust
desc: A travel and property listing platform designed to help users explore properties, filter listings, and move through a structured booking experience.
overview: A demonstration travel platform focused on property discovery and booking-related workflows. The project explores listing management, search and filtering, user accounts, booking flows, and property administration through a responsive interface.
